# Kautusang Bayan No. 03, Series of 1991

**Appropriation of Funds for Infrastructure Projects in Laang-Gugulin**

## Summary

This ordinance appropriates funds from the "Laang-Gugulin" (General Fund) for infrastructure projects for the year 1992. It allocates a total of P1,640,481.36 from the General Fund and P156,159.24 from the Infrastructure Fund for specific projects. The ordinance was enacted on September 2, 1991, in Pitogo, Quezon.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1:** Appropriates P1,640,481.36 from the General Fund for infrastructure projects in Laang-Gugulin. Also appropriates P156,159.24 from the Infrastructure Fund for the same purpose. The funds will come from the municipality's share in the Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) and the Local Government Revenue Stabilization Fund (LGRSF).
2.  **Section 2:** Appropriates the budget for 1992 for infrastructure projects in Laang-Gugulin, as indicated in the attached document.
3.  **Section 3:** The ordinance regarding Laang-Gugulin will take effect on January 1, 1992.
4.  **Section 4:** The ordinance was enacted on September 2, 1991, in Pitogo, Quezon.
